description: This Java source file defines the PolicyErrorResponseAdapter class, which maps PolicyErrorResponse objects to and from an internal Adaptable representation. It extends AbstractErrorResponseAdapter and implements PolicyAdapter, providing methods to create instances, build error responses from protocol data, and generate topic path builders based on policy error responses.

classes.name: PolicyErrorResponseAdapter
classes.description: A final class that adapts PolicyErrorResponse objects for protocol translation, managing error response building and topic path generation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of PolicyErrorResponseAdapter with provided header translator and error registry.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Generates a TopicPathBuilder based on the entity ID in the given error response.

methods.name: buildErrorResponse
methods.description: Constructs a PolicyErrorResponse object from a topic path, exception, and headers.
